changeSet.author: SDooley
changeSet.sql: ALTER procedure [utility].[GetFieldTypeLookupList] @type varchar(50), @id int as begin SELECT 'L' as type, 'Business Asset|' + cast(ObjectID as varchar) as value, 'Business Asset : ' + Name as title FROM AssetType where [Object] = 'ArtifactType' UNION SELECT 'L' as type, 'ReferenceItemType|0' as value, 'Reference List' as title UNION SELECT 'L' as type, 'ReferenceItem|' + cast(ObjectID as varchar) as value, 'Reference List Item: ' + Name as title FROM AssetType where [Object] = 'ReferenceItemType' UNION SELECT 'L' as type, 'Resource|1' as value, 'Resource : User' as title UNION SELECT 'L' as type, 'Taxonomy|' + cast(ObjectID as varchar) as value, 'Model : ' + Name as title FROM AssetType where [Object] = 'TaxonomyType' UNION SELECT 'L' as type, 'TaxonomyType|0' as value, 'Model Type' as title UNION SELECT 'L' as type, 'Lookup|' + cast(ID as varchar) as value, 'Lookup : ' + Name as title FROM LookupType end
changeSet.rollback: /****** Object: StoredProcedure [utility].[GetFieldTypeLookupList] Script Date: 15/10/2019 11:22:34 ******/ SET ANSI_NULLS ON GO SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON GO ALTER procedure [utility].[GetFieldTypeLookupList] @type varchar(50), @id int as begin SELECT 'L' as type, 'Artifact|' + cast(ObjectID as varchar) as value, 'Artifact : ' + Name as title FROM AssetType where [Object] = 'ArtifactType' UNION SELECT 'L' as type, 'ReferenceItemType|0' as value, 'Reference List' as title UNION SELECT 'L' as type, 'ReferenceItem|' + cast(ObjectID as varchar) as value, 'Reference List Item: ' + Name as title FROM AssetType where [Object] = 'ReferenceItemType' UNION SELECT 'L' as type, 'Resource|1' as value, 'Resource : User' as title UNION SELECT 'L' as type, 'Taxonomy|' + cast(ObjectID as varchar) as value, 'Model : ' + Name as title FROM AssetType where [Object] = 'TaxonomyType' UNION SELECT 'L' as type, 'TaxonomyType|0' as value, 'Model Type' as title UNION SELECT 'L' as type, 'Lookup|' + cast(ID as varchar) as value, 'Lookup : ' + Name as title FROM LookupType end
